claim_summary: For a complete fundamental su(d) generator basis, the Weyl-Gaussian heat measure is positive and integrates exp(X) to exp(t C2) in every finite representation; normalized exp(t C2 + J_B) is an exact positive mixture of identical local products for arbitrary Hermitian B (its scalar part cancels normalization).

The full-basis Casimir principal form is globally PSD on the full-rank density manifold with exact factorization 2 Tr[rho(Y-yI)rho(Y-yI)]. The isotropic Feynman-Kac SDE has no finite-time rank-loss from I/d by a logdet martingale bound.

For the spin-1 su(2) subalgebra inside su(3), the full-density principal tensor is not PSD: exact value -49/5000 at rho=diag(4/5,1/10,1/10) and tangent Y=(E12+E21)/5-9(E23+E32)/10, despite sum T_a^2=I/2.
evidence_scope: Exact SymPy fixtures verify one full-su(3) principal identity and the exact spin-1 counterexample; the all-d heat and SDE arguments are analytic derivations. No finite-bit sampler, complexity result, external audit, or priority claim.
